digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. Friday closes with all eight tracked priorities still open, six of them urgent, so Monday's value will come from turning today's meeting-heavy work into clear ownership and dates.

items.label: Set the governance path for OAA Brain
items.detail: Align with Jim on the Legal and IT approval path, required development, and which solution remains authoritative before more work advances.

items.label: Restore the paused Preparer Change production line
items.detail: Confirm the Business Application ticket includes the script, machine, errors, and requested work; assign the technical owner; and hold further task-set launches until Legal approves the revised process.

items.label: Reset the Amazon Connect critical path and go-live
items.detail: Secure the dependency-linked plan, AWS response and mitigation, daily standup time, and one leadership-ready go-live date.

items.label: Close the Bonus Restructure kickoff follow-through
items.detail: Confirm the project scope, current work, timeline, known risks, and owner of the next milestone after today's PM introduction.

items.label: Capture the missed Service Cloud decisions
items.detail: Close any coverage gaps from the 11:00 AM conflict and capture the decisions or follow-ups missed across the interview, launch-readiness Q&A, and spreadsheet work.

items.label: Prioritize the new critical Court work
items.detail: Rank the Court hearing notifications and Attorney Recommendation field work, assign owners, and confirm what moves first alongside the high-priority CLR items.

items.label: Close the Latent Variables reply
items.detail: Review Yash's response and decide whether it changes the fieldwork decision or needs a concise reply.

items.label: Prepare the SMS scripts for Monday's legal path
items.detail: Clarify the Bucket 1 checkbox, confirm Ariel's review and the Legal approval owner, and set the handoff sequence before templates go to IT.

items.label: 8:00 AM-noon - Week setup, Legal alignment, and focus time
items.detail: Timecards begin the day, Legal Change Management follows at 10:00 AM, and the noon Blocked Space is the cleanest window for unresolved governance and SMS follow-through.

items.label: 2:00-4:30 PM - Portfolio reviews, Maria's 1:1, and EPMO check-in
items.detail: BD Portfolio Review, Legal Projects Portfolio Review, Maria's 1:1, and the EPMO EOW check-in run consecutively. Prepare the ranked Court and intake decisions before the sequence begins.
